prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Happy 6-year-old Indian child model with radiant smile, energetic playful posture, wearing premium bespoke Kids Winter Jacket crafted from rich Fine Wool Blend, Thermal Fleece, Soft Quilted Shell in shades of Warm Beige, Soft Sage, Navy Blue. Intricate tailoring, pristine seam lines, tactile fabric weave, authentic drapery and natural folds. Setting: Sun-drenched botanical garden lawn or bright airy sunroom with natural light. Lighting: Bright, soft, diffused daylight with gentle pastel reflections. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Model is positioned towards the center-right. The left 40% has smooth cinematic falloff and clean negative space reserved for brand typography. Framing rule: Sophisticated three-quarter portrait showcasing authentic garment silhouette and drape.
